cases.title: Zero-order category silently missing from a monthly report
cases.sql:
SELECT c.name AS category,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
        FROM orders o
        JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id
          AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-12-%') AS cnt
FROM categories c
ORDER BY category ASC

cases.title: Individuals leaderboard topped by corporations
cases.sql:
SELECT c.full_name AS customer, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.entity_type IN (7, 8)
GROUP BY c.full_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, customer ASC
LIMIT 5

cases.title: Guessed entity_type code returns zero rows dressed as an answer
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.entity_type IN (7, 8)
  AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-%'

cases.title: Absolute growth question answered with percentage growth
cases.sql:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category,
         substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS y,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
  FROM categories c
  JOIN products p    ON p.category_id = c.category_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN orders o      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY c.name, y
)
SELECT a.category, b.cnt - a.cnt AS growth
FROM per a JOIN per b ON b.category = a.category
WHERE a.y = '2024' AND b.y = '2025'
ORDER BY growth DESC, a.category ASC
LIMIT 1

cases.title: Order counts inflated by item-level JOIN fan-out
cases.sql:
SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
FROM categories c
JOIN products p    ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, category ASC

cases.title: Monthly trend missing the month that had nothing
cases.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT m + 1 FROM months WHERE m < 12
)
SELECT printf('2025-%02d', m) AS month,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
        FROM orders o
        JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        WHERE p.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE name = 'garden')
          AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) = printf('2025-%02d', m)) AS cnt
FROM months
ORDER BY m ASC

cases.title: Top customers ranking swallowed by a NULL bucket
cases.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_name, ''), c.full_name) AS customer,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY customer
ORDER BY cnt DESC, customer ASC
LIMIT 10

cases.title: High-value scope filter dropped, the whole year counted
cases.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2025-%'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_totals
WHERE total > 500

cases.title: Top-3 ranking with a tie at third place
cases.sql:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
  FROM products p
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN orders o      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE p.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE name = 'toys')
    AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-%'
  GROUP BY p.name
)
SELECT product, units FROM u
WHERE units >= (SELECT units FROM u ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2)
ORDER BY units DESC, product ASC
